in_hindi.name: अनेकहा
in_hindi.meaning: अनेक (aneka) - many, numerous, various हा (hā) - form of 'hā' indicating existence or presence
in_hindi.long_meaning: The Hindi name 'Anekhā' is derived from the Sanskrit root 'aneka' which means 'many, numerous, various'. The 'hā' (हा) suffix in Hindi is used to indicate existence or presence.

in_marathi.name: Anekha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anekha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anekha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘aneka’, meaning ‘many, various, or unique’. In Hindu mythology, Anekha represents the unique individuality and diversity of every living being.
